description: Four independent sample-based drum voices in one 10HP panel: each channel plays one piece of a chosen vintage drum machine kit when triggered, and has its own audio output.

params.text: Selects that channel; pressing it on the channel already selected starts editing, and further presses step between the drum machine name and the kit piece. The encoder changes whichever one blinks
Sets the volume of the selected channel from 0% to 100% while nothing is blinking, and picks the drum machine or the kit piece while the channel is being edited

inputs.text: Fires that channel's drum sound; the trigger is taken on the way up past 1.7V and rearms below 0.2V

notes: an edit started with a channel button ends by itself after 30 seconds with no encoder or button movement.
to hear a sound before choosing it, unpatch that channel's TRIG. jack. With the jack empty, selecting a drum machine or a kit piece plays it once; with a cable in it, that preview is off.
the module reads only the first channel of a cable and sends one channel out, whatever the cable's width, because a drum hit needs no polyphony.
without an OhmerPrems licence keyfile five of the sixteen drum machines sound: Oberheim DMX, Drumulator, LinnDrum, Roland 707 and 808. The rest select but stay silent, with a red channel LED
